findings.quote: The average concurrent-flow flame spread rate is 1.8 mm/s. The opposed-flow flame average spread rate 1.3 mm/s.
findings.about: Saffire-I opposed-flow burn: average flame spread rate

findings.quote: For the concurrent flame, the length reaches a plateau value of around 40 mm, while the opposed-flow flame is a bit shorter at 24 mm.
findings.about: Saffire-I flame length: plateau of about 40 mm (concurrent) and 24 mm (opposed) (no site variable)

findings.quote: About 90% of the fuel burned in the first test leaving 10% unburned, allowing a meaningful opposed-flow test to be completed.
findings.about: Saffire-I: share of the large sample burned in the concurrent test

findings.quote: Saffire 1: 165 W (for 8 s); 4.1 W/cm (per unit fuel width)
findings.note: Disagrees with Table I of the same presentation (p. 29) and with PSI's table, which give 182 W for samples 1-1 and 1-2.
